text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Special Week—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That one, right there! —The crane game!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Special Week was pointing, I 
saw a claw machine filled with plushies 
modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoaaaa...! As expected of the 
big city, they even have merchandise like 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice... I wonder if Mom would be 
happy if I sent her one...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's eyes were sparkling as 
brightly as they possibly could...
choice_data_list: ...Want me to get that for you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
